protocol.scope: Retrospective research model for reporting-carrier US domestic flights; no private-flight probabilities
protocol.learner: Fixed L2 logistic regression; sequential cancellation, diversion (arrivals), and delay heads; no class rebalancing
protocol.selection: Publish the pre-specified weather model as experimental; report baseline comparison even when unfavorable. Do not tune against the final test.
protocol.calibration: Disjoint October probability calibration and November interval calibration; neither refits the feature model
protocol.interval: Split-conformal absolute error band for the observed 2-hour disruption share; not a confidence interval for a particular flight
protocol.fairHorizonComparison: Require a complete, supported TAF at all three horizons for the common evaluation cohort; report exclusions
protocol.releaseLag: Final evaluation starts more than three months after the last calibration outcome period. Final-vintage BTS records are used; historical revisions and release vintages are not reconstructed.
limitations: Historical weather delivery is approximated by issue/product time plus lag
Time-series conformal coverage is empirical, not guaranteed
No causal attribution of disruption to weather
